attempts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserving single static character sprite for Infernal Versus. Draw the HUMAN incarnation of ALASTOR from the official Hazbin Hotel Season 2 flashback, as shown in the three supplied Prime Video reference frames. Image 1 (2 seconds) governs his complete slender body, dark fitted trousers, low black pointed shoes, waistcoat silhouette and daylight palette. Image 2 (4 seconds) governs his warm brown skin, swept dark brown-black curls with reddish highlights, narrow oval spectacles, freckles, angular smiling face and long red necktie. Image 3 (20 seconds) governs the ivory shirt sleeves, dark sleeve garters, burgundy waistcoat and its long pointed lower contour. Keep exactly this human costume and anatomy. One complete full-body character, in a calm upright standing pose, three-quarter side view facing screen-right, one relaxed open hand, the other by his side. Reproduce the show's crisp expressive black 2D animation outlines and flat cel colors. Match his tall narrow human proportions; no deer antlers, no demon ears, no tail, no supernatural transformation. Show the whole hairstyle, fingers and both shoes inside the canvas with at least 7 percent transparent padding on every side. True transparent RGBA background. No floor, scene, cast shadow, words, logos, frame, glass, microphone, weapon, other character, second pose, multi-panel sheet or animation. This is a single clothed human character portrait intended as a static archive/costume sprite.

Create ONE complete full-body static 2D character sprite of HUMAN VOX from Hazbin Hotel Season 2 as directly shown in the supplied official Prime Video Brighter frames. Preserve his pointed human face, pale skin, green eyes, rectangular black spectacles, narrow long-limbed build, angular upswept dark hair with its pale streak and confident narrow grin. No television head, no antennas, no demon anatomy. Match the show's sharp black cartoon outlines, flat colors and restrained cel shading. A calm upright three-quarter pose facing screen-right, both feet visible and clearly separate, hands relaxed. Keep the entire hair, fingers and shoes within generous transparent margins. True fully transparent RGBA background with opaque character fills. No floor, scenery, cast shadow, glow, lettering, logo, frame, extra character, other pose, multi-panel sheet or animation. Draw this one specific official outfit, without combining different costumes. The weather-presenter costume: use Image 1 at14 seconds for the whole body and exact dark brown/burgundy suit and narrow trousers; Image 2 at12 seconds supplies the face, hair, glasses and suit front; Image 3 at10 seconds supplies the collar, pale shirt and thin light tie and the small golden lapel accent visible in this incarnation. Brown pointed-shoulder suit jacket, pale shirt, light muted tie, matching dark trousers and black pointed low shoes. Do not add a microphone, weapon, map pointer or weather board. The pose is a neutral static adaptation for the archive.

Create ONE complete full-body static 2D character sprite of HUMAN VOX from Hazbin Hotel Season 2 as directly shown in the supplied official Prime Video Brighter frames. Preserve his pointed human face, pale skin, green eyes, rectangular black spectacles, narrow long-limbed build, angular upswept dark hair with its pale streak and confident narrow grin. No television head, no antennas, no demon anatomy. Match the show's sharp black cartoon outlines, flat colors and restrained cel shading. A calm upright three-quarter pose facing screen-right, both feet visible and clearly separate, hands relaxed. Keep the entire hair, fingers and shoes within generous transparent margins. True fully transparent RGBA background with opaque character fills. No floor, scenery, cast shadow, glow, lettering, logo, frame, extra character, other pose, multi-panel sheet or animation. Draw this one specific official outfit, without combining different costumes. The pale mint-green/teal talk-show performer's suit shown in these references: Image 1 at58 seconds governs the whole outfit, narrow legs and long jacket contour; Image 2 at62 seconds shows pale lapels, white shirt with black buttons, small BLACK bow tie and hand proportions; Image 3 at66 seconds governs mint-green trouser hems and low pointed black shoes with their tiny light toe accents. Preserve the contrast between the pale jacket front and the teal trouser panels as observed. Draw both hands empty and relaxed: do not include the scene's microphone, wire, audience or stage. Do not use the brown weather-presenter suit or the later black tuxedo. The pose is a neutral static adaptation for the archive.

Use case: identity-preserving static game sprite, one image only. Create Lute from Hazbin Hotel in the Season 2 Gravity incarnation, with her LEFT arm replaced by the golden articulated prosthetic shown in the references and Adam's pale glowing halo worn around that prosthetic wrist. Reference image 1 shows her complete silhouette at 56 seconds of the official Prime Video Gravity clip; reference image 2 shows the wrist and articulated hand; reference image 3 governs face, asymmetrical short pale bob, dark grey tunic with pale collar and belt contour, black high boots, and black-and-grey feathered wings. Preserve her white/pale skin, pale gold eyes with black makeup, thin black overhead halo with central dark element, and the exact narrow angular silhouette. Her biological RIGHT arm remains ordinary pale skin; do not mirror the prosthesis to the wrong side. One complete full-body static 2D sprite, shallow three-quarter view facing right, calm alert standing pose with both hands lowered and wings partially relaxed so their full tips remain visible. Draw the same outfit and anatomy, no new armor or weapon. Clean sharp series-like 2D cel animation contours, flat opaque fills, restrained existing shading, crisp identity details. All boots, fingers, hair, halo and wing tips must fit inside the canvas with generous transparent padding. Real transparent RGBA background, no floor, no scenery, no cast shadow, no aura outside the wrist halo, no lettering, no label, no additional person, no duplicate pose, no sprite sheet. Do not recreate the many-panel reference board, only a single isolated Lute.

Use case: identity-preserving static alternate-form sprite. Create ONE isolated full-body EMILY from Hazbin Hotel Season 2 in her SIX-WINGED floating presentation, as directly shown in these official Prime Video frames. Image 1, at200 seconds of the official Egg Boiz compilation, governs her complete floating silhouette, all three pairs of deployed feathered wings, crown-like halo, rounded dress hem and pointed feet. Image 2, at195 seconds, governs her face, large lavender-blue eyes with dark lashes, pale grey-lavender skin, soft pale lilac hair with asymmetrical fringe, and small white cheek freckles. Image 3, at235 seconds, corroborates the complete outline and lower legs/feet. Preserve her short puff sleeves, pale lilac dress, small dark four-petal chest emblem, and the darker lavender pointed zigzag-and-diamond hem pattern. She has exactly SIX feathered wings: three separate layered pairs emerging behind her torso, with long narrow pale feathers, all tips fully visible and distinct. Do not mistake long hair for another wing or add extra limbs. Her luminous pale crown halo has the same small upright droplet points as the reference. Pose: calmly floating upright, slightly three-quarter facing right, hands gently open at her sides and feet just below the hem, peaceful alert expression. This is a static archive illustration of the already documented winged state, not a new costume or a redesign. Crisp black/dark-lavender 2D series-style animation outlines, flat opaque cel colors and minimal reference-consistent shadows. Use a wide enough canvas to leave at least 7 percent real transparent margin around ALL six wings, halo and feet. True transparent RGBA background, no magical aura or broad glow, no ground, shadow, clouds, scenery, companions, eggs, lettering, captions, logos, frame, duplicate views or animation frames.
